title: UNVERIFIED — The Motel Without Fee

features.name: reception
features.desc-on-touch: A bed of pigeon disjecta and due notices. Nobody has come for the notices. The pigeons have raised a new generation of squabs, who walk the hallways and tend to all raised surfaces.

features.name: the hinge
features.desc-on-touch: Holding a manhole open above reception, where pigeons come and go and a tree is growing vines out through the ceiling cavity. A temporary file asks that it be left where it is. It was.

features.name: a templated oil drum, tins of soup and chilli con carne
features.desc-on-touch: On the gravel yard below the open window. He recognises a dinner in what is left of the tins.

features.name: a second floor window, open
features.desc-on-touch: Step carefully onto the sill. Only pull enough weight on the guttering to steady yourself. There is a necklace of bricks beneath the roof tiles. Halfway up, a knee has to be persuaded.

reverie.title: REVERIE — a gravel yard, the last of the light
narr: She crouched beside the drum in the last of the light.
She turned the pot so the handle pointed towards you, and sat back.
The radio was playing. She was certain about the singer. She was wrong.
When the announcer was about to say, she reached over and turned it off.
It's all just a lot of buzzing, she said. She got up to dance,
knees slightly bent, drop to the heel, pivot east, south.
